page.overview:
Who is Masachika?

Masachika is a character mentioned in War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. He was a famous blacksmith who forged the Mournblade, a weapon said to be capable of defeating even the Realmscourge.

"Masachika" was known as Thorbek, the great-grandson of Quill, the man who found Sadali Crysthea and Exia when they first set foot on Ardra. Like his ancestors since that time, Quill became a steward for Sadali and devoted his life to supporting him. He eventually accompanied his master to the cave below Leonis, where the allied armies united under Sadali were to fight the Realmscourge. However, despite their best efforts, they were unable to defeat the monstrosity, and any attempt at retreat was foiled by Khury Wezette, who blew up the entrance to the cavern. While Gilgamesh and Amnelis arrived in time to save Sadali, Exia, and Thorbek, Sadali insisted on making his last stand, as his wounds were too severe to run away now. Despite this, their defeat was inevitable. As a last-ditch effort, Exia infused Gilgamesh's exhausted crystal with her very essence so they could rewind time once more, but the power was so strong that everyone in the vicinity was affected, including the Realmscourge and Thorbek.

Having been returned to a time before his own birth, Thorbek ended up as nothing but an incorporeal soul, wandering aimlessly until he found the body of an ancestor of his, which he was able to possess. Consumed by his fear of the unstoppable calamity that was the Realmscourge, Thorbek tried to warn the people of the danger, but this only led to him being shunned as a madman. Now living a life of solitude, he swore to create a weapon capable of slaying the monstrosity.

Under the name Masachika, he became a swordsmith and rose to great fame. Taking on many apprentices, Masachika was eventually able to forge his masterpiece: Mournblade. Displeased by his apprentices going around claiming they had helped forge Mournblade, Masachika killed most of them as a warning to the rest.
